introHtml: When you need a first aid kit that can travel with your crew, the handle makes all the difference. Unlike basic wall-mounted kits, these portable units let safety managers grab and go during emergencies or outdoor events. The Storm Series Disaster & First Aid Kit, for example, includes a sturdy handle for quick deployment. Custom imprint your logo on the durable case for year-round brand visibility at job sites, trade shows, or company picnics.
